Here we are only interested in the change of the interval size with the addition of dp, so the data related to the phenotype won't be loaded 

```{r get rp, dp, ZmPR list, echo=TRUE, message=T}

# dp_rp_list_pval_significant <- "3_1" 

ZmPR_list <- grep("^.*/ZmPR([0-9]+)_.*", params$input_file) 
  
median_pval_adjusted <-  fread(file.path(params$input_file), header = T)

dp_rp_median <- median_pval_adjusted %>%
dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
tidyr::separate(dp_rp, c("dp", "rp") , "_", remove = F) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
    if (dplyr::first(rp) == 1) rp == 1
    else rp == 2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(dp_rp) %>%
  dplyr::slice(c(params$n_row)) ## to remove #:2, 5, 10,13,14


```

We keep only the genotypes introgressed in ZmPR 4 region (targeted region) and no other introgression in the background, meaning we work with NILs belonging to group A

```{r get the genotypes to work on}

groupA_NILs <-  fread(file.path(params$group_A), header = T)

geno_group <- groupA_NILs  %>%
      dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", entryid)),
                    dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", entryid)), 
                    qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", entryid))) %>%
  tidyr::unite("dp_rp", dp, rp, remove = F) %>%
      dplyr::filter( dp_rp %in% dp_rp_median$dp_rp ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(qtl %in% ZmPR_list) %>%
      droplevels 

```

We get pheno data to perform t-test at the end 

```{r manupilation of phenotypic data}

# haplotype_slope <- read.csv(paste0(source_path, "haplotype_slope_20240921.csv"), header = T)

haplotype_slope <-  fread(file.path(params$pheno_data), header = T)

phenotype_zmpr4 <- haplotype_slope %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g[0-9]|i.*", "", haplotype)),
                dp = as.numeric(gsub(".*g|[0-9]i.*", "", haplotype)),
                qtl = as.numeric(gsub(".*q|g.*", "", haplotype))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(entryid2 = haplotype) %>%
  tidyr::unite("dp_rp", dp, rp, remove = F) %>%
  # dplyr::filter(rp %in% rp_list) %>%
  # dplyr::filter(dp %in% dp_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dp_rp %in% dp_rp_median$dp_rp) %>%
  dplyr::filter(qtl %in% ZmPR_list) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  dplyr::filter(entryid2 %in% unique(geno_group$entryid)) %>% ## keep only the NILs of group A
  dplyr::mutate(
    i = str_extract(entryid2, "i\\d+"),
    i = str_extract(i, "\\d{2}"),
    i = factor(
      i,
      levels = c(
        "12",
        "11",
        "10",
        "09",
        "08",
        "07",
        "06",
        "05",
        "04",
        "03",
        "02",
        "01"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Sample  = entryid2) 


### Transform the estimate 

min_value <- phenotype_zmpr4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rp, dp) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(min_value = abs(min(Estimate, na.rm = T)))

phenotype_zmpr4 <- phenotype_zmpr4 %>% 
  dplyr::full_join(min_value) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Estimate_transformed = Estimate + min_value, 
                Estimate_of_origin = ifelse(Estimate_transformed < min_value, 0, Estimate),
                Addition = ifelse(Estimate < 0, min_value - abs(Estimate) , min_value), 
                Sample = as.factor(Sample)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Estimate_of_origin, Addition), 
                      names_to = "Type", 
                      values_to = "values") %>%
  # dplyr::arrange(desc(Estimate_transformed)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

```

```{r order the lines by breakpoints}

## Create a list to define the order of the samples for the rest of the analysis
only_RP_sample <- geno_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!any(geno == "DP")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()## some sample are only RP, but we still keep them it they are not introgessed with DP elsewhere in the genome 

list_RP_geno <-  (unique(only_RP_sample$Sample))
sample_order <- geno_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(geno == "DP") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, rp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(min_i_start = min(i.start, na.rm = TRUE))

sample_order <- dput(levels(reorder(sample_order$Sample, (sample_order$min_i_start))))
sample_order <- dput(c(list_RP_geno, sample_order))

## Order genotypes dataset
calculation_file <- geno_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, marker) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dim_interval = i.end - i.start) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample = as.factor(Sample), 
                Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order)) #or sample_order

```

```{r function to extract the begin and end base paire of each interval}

get_segment <- function(difference) {
  seg <- integer(length(difference))
  seg[1] <- 1L

  for (i in 2:length(difference)) {
    seg[i] <- seg[i - 1]
    if (difference[i] > 0) {
      seg[i] <- seg[i] + 1L
    }
  }
  seg
}

```

```{r}
dataframe_interval <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(calculation_file, as.factor(calculation_file$Sample)), function(x){

  }else{
  
  result <-  x%>%
    as.data.frame()%>%
    dplyr::arrange(marker)  %>%
    dplyr::mutate( 
                   diff = if_else(
      dplyr::row_number() == 1,
      0,
      i.start - dplyr::lag(i.end)), 
             segment = get_segment(diff)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(segment, rp, dp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    begin = min(i.start, na.rm = TRUE),
    end   = max(i.end, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  }
}))

i.start <- dataframe_interval$begin
i.end <- dataframe_interval$end
interval_list <- c(i.start, i.end)
interval_list <- unique(interval_list)
interval_list <- sort(interval_list)
```

```{r define the interval value}

# Get mean size of segments in the targeted region of the NILs 
# mean_interval <- mean(calculation_file$dim_interval, na.rm =T)

# Define in which interval the segment falls 
dataset_final <- NULL
dataset_to_return <- NULL
table_for_fine_mapping <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    split(calculation_file, calculation_file$Sample),
    function(x) {
    # x <- split(calculation_file,as.factor(calculation_file$Sample))[[1]]

       dataset_final <- NULL
      # a <- 1
      
      for (i in 1:nrow(x)) {
            # print(i)

        # i <- 5  # remove after debugging

        dataset1 <- x[i, ]
        snp_start <- x$i.start[i]
        snp_end <- x$i.end[i]
        max_snp_end <- tail(x$i.end, 1)
        
        a <- 1
        interval_begin <- interval_list[[a]]
        interval_end <- interval_list[[a + 1]]
        end_max <- tail(interval_list, 1)
        
        if (snp_start < interval_end & snp_end > interval_end & snp_start < end_max ) {

          while (snp_end > interval_end) {
            a <- a + 1
            interval_begin <- interval_list[[a]]
            interval_end <- interval_list[[a + 1]]
          }

          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else if (snp_start >= interval_end & snp_start < end_max) {

          while (snp_start >= interval_end) {
            a <- a + 1
            interval_begin <- interval_list[[a]]
            interval_end <- interval_list[[a + 1]]
          }

          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else if (snp_end == max_snp_end & max_snp_end < end_max) {

          a <- length(interval_list)
          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else if (snp_end > end_max) {

          a <- NA
          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        } else {

          dataset1[, "interval"] <- a
          dataset_final <- rbind(dataset_final, dataset1)

        }

      }

      dataset_final
    }
  )
)
```

```{r exclude beginning and end interval where there are NA genotypes}

start_point_sample<- calculation_file %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(start_point = min(i.start, na.rm =T))

start_point_interval_ttest <- max(unique(start_point_sample$start_point))

end_point_sample<- calculation_file %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(end_point = max(i.end, na.rm =T))

end_point_interval_ttest <- min(unique(end_point_sample$end_point))

```

```{r calculate value of the interval}

table_for_fine_mapping <- table_for_fine_mapping %>%
  dplyr::filter(i.start > start_point_interval_ttest &
                  i.end < end_point_interval_ttest) 

table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content <- table_for_fine_mapping %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample, interval) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RP = sum(geno == "RP") / n(), DP = 1 - RP, 
                i.start = min(i.start), 
                i.end = max(i.end)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, RP, DP, interval, i.start, i.end) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() 

interval_with_DP <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content %>%
  dplyr::group_by(interval) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(sum_DP = sum(DP, na.rm = T),
                   sum_RP = sum(RP, na.rm = T)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sum_DP == 0 | sum_DP == 1 | sum_RP == 0 | sum_RP == 1 | sum_DP < 1) ## if there is 0 or only 1 segment with RP or DP then the mean can't be calculated 

interval_for_plotting <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(interval) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(i.start = min(i.start, na.rm =T),
                   i.end = max(i.end, na.rm = T))

```


```{r extract p-val associated to the interval}

ttest_pval <- table_for_fine_mapping_interval_content %>%
  dplyr::full_join(phenotype_zmpr4[, c("Sample", "Estimate_transformed")] %>%
                  dplyr::distinct()) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = RP:DP,
                      names_to = "geno",
                      values_to = "geno_value") %>%
  dplyr::filter(geno_value != 0 &
                  !(interval %in% unique(interval_with_DP$interval))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(interval) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(pval = t.test(Estimate_transformed ~ geno)$p.value, .groups = "drop", var.equal = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pval_adjusted = p.adjust(pval,method="BH"))

```

```{r zone size where pval_adjusted < 0.05}


zone_info <- ttest_pval %>% #ttest_pval
  # dplyr::filter(!is.na(rp)) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(interval_for_plotting) %>%
  dplyr::filter(pval_adjusted < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(zone = ifelse(dplyr::row_number() == 1 | (interval -lag(interval)) == 1, 1,  NA),
                zone = ifelse(is.na(zone), lag(zone) + 1, zone))

zone_size <- zone_info %>%
dplyr::group_by(zone) %>%
dplyr::summarise(zone_size = max(i.end, na.rm = T) - min(i.start, na.rm = T),
                 Number_of_dp = nrow(dp_rp_median))

write.csv(
  zone_size,
  file.path(params$output_dir, paste0("ZmPR", ZmPR_list, "_", date_today, length(dp_rp_median) ,"zone.csv")),
  row.names = TRUE
)
```
